title: Sources: Binance is set to lose permission to offer services to EU clients from the start of July as its application for a license is about to be turned down (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Sources: Binance is set to lose permission to offer services to EU clients from the start of July as its application for a license is about to be turned down — Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, is set to lose permission to offer services to European Union clients within weeks …
